goal_provenance.shared_trunk_justification: shared ENCODER, not a shared signal; attributability comes from the zero-init gates, and a shared trunk cannot launder a signal that is absent from the graph
goal_provenance.label_source: tanitad.data.lan.lan_window_features (ego future path, arc-length resampled, leak-guarded) — TRAIN ONLY; never read at inference
goal_provenance.admissibility_check: could this goal have been computed from the situation classifier's output? NO — that output is not in the graph, is not a batch field, and is not a label source here.

inference_inputs_of_goals: ego_state @ t0 = (v0, a_long, yaw_rate, curvature, keep) — MEASURED at the last OBSERVED frame (E11')
refused_edges: situation classifier output -> any goal node (PI 2026-08-03, UNCHANGED)
future_poses/future_actions -> any goal node (E11'; the PI's 'not the future one', pinned interventionally)
provenance_roles.shared_trunk: encoder (common ancestor, declared; zero-init gates carry attributability)
provenance_roles._reads: `required_live_edges` is not decoration: an arm where the SCENE edge does not fire is ECHOING, and an arm where the EGO edge does not fire is v3 wearing a v4 config. Both are failures and both are measured.

selection.note: horizon_s is DERIVED from max(horizons); the 72.08 % / 77.28 % kill statistics quoted elsewhere are 2 s numbers and do NOT hold here (re-derived 2026-09-04).

ego.derivation: t0 = last OBSERVED frame; a_long = corpus ax (actions[:,-1,1]); curvature = tan(steer)/2.9 (actions[:,-1,0]); yaw_rate = v0*curvature. NO finite differencing, NO future read.

nav_cmd_derivation: v7.2 nav_command token (oracle, provenance ego-future; allow_oracle_nav=True)

train.derivation: v7.2 nav_command token (oracle, provenance ego-future; allow_oracle_nav=True)

eval.derivation: v7.2 nav_command token (oracle, provenance ego-future; allow_oracle_nav=True)
